title: Challenging the 'embarrassingly sequential': parallelizing finite state machine-based computations through principled speculation
relevance: Seminal paper on speculative FSM parallelization. Showed that sequential FSM computations can be parallelized with principled speculation achieving significant speedups.

title: Combining SIMD and Many/Multi-core Parallelism for Finite State Machines with Enumerative Speculation
relevance: Introduced enumerative speculation for FSMs using SIMD. Achieved up to 2.5x speedup on 1 core and 95x combining SIMD with 60 cores for Huffman decoding.

title: GSpecPal: Speculation-Centric Finite State Machine Parallelization on GPUs
relevance: GPU-based speculative FSM parallelization achieving 7.2x average speedup (up to 20x) with speculative recovery and heuristic thread scheduling.

title: MicroSpec: Speculation-Centric Fine-Grained Parallelization for FSM Computations
relevance: Fine-grained speculative parallelism for FSMs exploiting ILP and SIMD. First to expose fine-grained hardware parallelism for FSM computations.

title: Scaling out speculative execution of finite-state machines with parallel merge
relevance: Addresses the scalability bottleneck of speculative FSM parallelization on GPUs through efficient parallel merge techniques.
